title: DUMBO in an hour — a family of four
description: A four-stop walking tour from the Brooklyn Bridge to the Manhattan Bridge, dwelling at each stop and taking photographs. Routed on the OpenStreetMap pedestrian network at a family walking pace, then dressed with narration, look-at targets, photo moments and a hand-off into the Manhattan Bridge team's inspect mode.

title: Step-free waterfront short loop
description: A brief, level, wheelchair-friendly walk along the Brooklyn Bridge Park edge.
